notes.title: Love Life version 1.1.8 Update!
notes.notes:
Love Life version 1.1.8
---
We've fixed a number of bugs, including:

- Fixed a bug where it was possible to keep cheating on the wheel of misfortune as long as the player had coins.
- Fixed a bug where after fixing a feeling repressed problem by taking love juice, the character could never 'come out' to anyone.
- Fixed some text issues and typos
- Fixed a bug where some sound effects wouldn't always play

Enjoy kittens!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello kittens! It’s finally here, our gift to you for all your support. Please enjoy the new features and improvements and let us know about any issues!

New Features
---
- Kitty's Weekly Missions - Kitty sets you three missions to complete every week! You'll earn coins for each mission you complete and you might even be rewarded with a gift!
- Move Locations - Locations that you've built in the village can be moved to a different area! You can still demolish them if you need to, but moving them instead means that any activities or events taking place there don't need to be rearranged!
- Friend Leaderboards - Compete against your friends to see who can make the most money and the most promotion points in a week!
- Couple Eviction - If a couple is proving troublesome to level up and it's clear that they're not right for each other, you can pay to evict them from the village. It'll cost you some reputation, but that could be better than struggling to force two residents to love each other!
- Money Bird Combo - Catch the bird on successive days, and you'll see its two new friends and get additional cash!
- Cloud Saves

Improvements & Bug Fixes
---
- Scrollable lists have the same scroll speed.
- Problem penalties are not applied to the the six segment Wheel of Destiny.
- The Wheel of Misfortune and Wheel of Destiny have a power bar for controlling the spin speed.
- Fixed a bug on the friend import screen where the same friend could be chosen for both characters.
- Fixed a bug where decorations would be left on the map after demolishing the road.
- Fixed a bug with the 'Spice of Life' achievement where it required 31 different problems to complete instead of 30.
- Fixed a bug with the private message inbox containing messages from characters that have moved out.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
Well Kittens, it's about time we added some improvements to the game, based on all your feedback!

In the next few days we'll be releasing the first major update to Love Life, adding some much requested features plus some things we think you'll enjoy! :-)

Kitty's Weekly Missions - Kitty sets you three missions to complete every week! You'll earn coins for each mission you complete and you might even be rewarded with a gift!

Move Locations - Locations that you've built in the village can be moved to a different area! You can still demolish them if you need to, but moving them instead means that any activities or events taking place there don't need to be rearranged!

Friend Leaderboards - Compete against your friends to see who can make the most money and the most promotion points in a week!

Couple Eviction - If a couple is proving troublesome to level up and it's clear that they're not right for each other, you can pay to evict them from the village. It'll cost you some reputation, but that could be better than struggling to force two residents to love each other!

Money Bird Combo - Catch the bird on successive days, and you'll see its two new friends and get additional cash!! 

Cloud Saves - Back up your save files on the cloud. Start on one device and continue on another.

Wheel Improvements - Wheels of Misfortune and Destiny now have power bars to allow you some agency in your spins, and we will no longer be adding problem penalties to the six segment Wheel of Destiny (during break ups etc)!

All these delicious morsels plus some bug fixes will be in the update! I can't wait!

Love, Kitty Powers xoxo

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hello kittens!

Ben's been a busy beaver and fixed a load of bugs and improved some bits just for you!

Here's the changelist for the latest update!

- Improved the friends list UI to show which activites can't be done because of a change in scheduling, and show how many strikes friends have.
- Improved Kitty's fashion tips in the Salon so that it's clearer if the currently selected type likes the appearance option.
- Updated the 'Import from Matchmaker' screen with more information and a link to the FAQ.
- Fixed some bugs with the end of game scenario so that it doesn't get stuck partway through.
- Fixed bugs with gift placement when giving to a partner during a level up.
- Fixed a bug where the 'Pick a Problem' message could get stuck on in the office.
- Fixed a bug where the wrong eyes were sometimes used in Alien mode.
- Fixed some bugs with alien mode activation.
- Fixed a bug where the location popup would sometimes not say which activity the character was doing.
- Achievements unlocked locally but not on Steam will update when the game is loaded.
- Made the photofit game slightly easier.
- Other small bug fixes and improvements

Enjoy kittens!

Kitty xoxo

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 Changelist
notes.notes:
Hello kittens,

thanks for all of your feedback and help to squash these bugs!

Version 1.0.8 changelist
---

- Fixed a bug where promotion points appeared to have no effect at level 19.
- Fixed some bugs with achievements ('Wakey Wakey' unlocking early, 'Numismitist Extraordinaire!' not unlocking, 'Master of Ceremonies' and 'Spoilt for Choice!' not counting up)
- Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't load from the title screen if the player has just reached level 6.
- Fixed a bug where a resident in the lobby would be off the side of the screen.
- Fixed a bug where imported friends horoscopes were incorrect.
- Fixed a bug where the game could get stuck if two residents tried to make friends at the wrong location.
- Fixed a bug where salon appointments could be scheduled when the salon was closed.
- Fixed typos.
- Clicking Regina on the map gives you more coins, but she's slightly harder to catch!

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Hello kittens!

We've been working hard to fix some of the bugs that you've been reporting since launch. Thanks so much for your patience and feedback, it has helped us tremendously. We've just released version 1.0.7 which sorts out the following issues.

- Fixed a bug which caused the game to display an event that couldn't be responded to.
- Achievement progress is now tracked.
- Fixed a bug where clicking the appearance buttons when creating a character would take you to the wrong menu.
- Fixed typos.
- Other small bug fixes.

We are continuing to make fixes and improvements, and will update again soon!

Love, Kitty Powers xoxo
